Factors that determine the fate of the characters 
 Global Sports Desk / TIMESOFINDIA.COM / Nov 18, 2026, 23:44 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print Does GTA 6 actually have multiple endings? (Image via Rockstar Games) GTA 6 is here, and one of the biggest unanswered questions is how the story ends. Will Jason and Lucia's fate be fixed, or will your choices decide it? In the section below, we take a look at what is confirmed about GTA 6's endings, what's rumored, and what the series' history suggests. This article contains no story spoilers, and you can read through without worrying about the game's actual ending being spoiled. What Rockstar has confirmed about GTA 6's endings
 Rockstar hasn't revealed the ending, the villain, or how many endings there are. A pre-launch summary of confirmed facts lists multiple endings as "not announced." What is confirmed is that the Criminal Profile influences the story and that the story is split into chapters. However, in line with reviews and those who have completed the game, choices in the later chapters shape where Jason and Lucia end up together, which points to more than one possible ending. Nevertheless, the number of endings and their triggers haven't been detailed. Rockstar's track record
 History is the strongest argument for branching endings. GTA V offered three endings and Red Dead Redemption 2 offered four, so a choice-driven finish fits the studio's pattern. The Bonnie and Clyde dynamic between Lucia and Jason creates natural branching points where choices could decide whether both, one, or neither survive. The outcome in older games usually came down to a final decision or an honor-style system, and fans are watching for something similar. Fan theories
 Speculation is plentiful. One popular theory is four endings based on personality paths, such as "romantic and cool" or "pragmatic and chaotic." Other fans picture a Bonnie and Clyde ending where both go out together, one character dying, or both surviving. The theory with the most traction is the possibility of a death, though it has no strong sourcing and the most reliable insiders haven't published anything on endings. Join conversation

 Factors that could shape the outcome of GTA 6's ending
 These are the factors that will shape your GTA 6 ending: The relationship between Jason and Lucia: What either character does can steer the relationship, and the arc, in a positive or negative direction.
 Your Criminal Profile: Since it affects the story, how you treat Leonida may matter.
 A final-chapter decision: Rockstar has a history of ending its stories with a key choice.
 Hidden tracking: Fans on Reddit wonder whether a morality or relationship system could track Jason and Lucia separately, but Rockstar hasn't confirmed an honor system.
 If you want a spoiler-free experience, avoid the rumor roundups that circulate around launch. The reliable answer will come from playing the game. If you care about getting a particular outcome, treating the relationship thoughtfully and keeping an eye on your Criminal Profile is a reasonable approach. This was all you needed to know about GTA 6 having multiple endings and the factors determining the same.
